structured_output.what_is_happening: A cluster of 'Effective Accelerationism / e/acc' tokens was launched in the same roughly 30-minute window. The GeckoTerminal handle points to a beffjezos status, so a Beff Jezos post probably set it off. This pair is 20 minutes old, not launched on pump.fun (deploy platform unknown, pumpswap pair), and at about $27k market cap. It has done about $470k in volume, 13.7x its market cap, and is up about 160%. There are 2,056 unique buyers against only 52 unique sellers. At least 10 same-name copies exist. The leader (CbcyNo7) is at $324k market cap with $2M of volume in the last hour.

narrative.description: e/acc / Effective Accelerationism meme, apparently set off by a Beff Jezos X post. The meme is well known in the tech and AI crowd.
narrative.why_spreading: A post from a well-known figure set off a race of copycat deploys. Attention is split across 10+ clones.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the name and ticker match. The social link points to the tweet itself, not to a project. Nothing marks this contract as the official one.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7 ($324k market cap, $2.08M volume in 1h, created about 9 minutes earlier) is the clear leader. EnmeFDQ5, EsVbL6GV, 6TrwU9oA and DseCuJgA also have heavy volume. An older 2024 pump.fun e/acc exists as well.

authenticity.evidence: There are 2,056 unique buyers but only 52 unique sellers, and 1,372 of those buyers arrived within 15 minutes. That looks like airdrop-style or bot-driven buy spreading, with a few wallets doing the selling. GMGN flags 38 bundler wallets holding 23.6% among top traders. Fresh-wallet and sniper counts are zero, smart-money and KOL counts are zero, and GMGN page visits are only 63 despite about 2,000 holders.
authenticity.uncertainty: The GeckoTerminal unique-seller count may be undercounted, and bots may simply be spraying buys across every clone.

structural_risks: Non-pump.fun deploy with LP burn ratio 0, so the LP can be pulled
Liquidity ($34k) is higher than market cap ($27k), a typical setup for manufactured clones
Creator already closed out, and it is their second launch
It is one of 10+ clones, and the leader is 12x bigger
Few sellers and many buyers suggests the coin is being farmed

structured_output.counterargument: The meme and trigger are real and fresh. Clone races sometimes lift lagging copies when the leader runs, and at $27k a move to $55k needs little capital. Buyers still outnumber sellers and price is near its all-time high with rising 5-minute momentum.
unknowns: Whether the creator controls the LP
Whether Beff Jezos endorsed any contract
How strong the tweet's reach is

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical e/acc clone in a crowded copycat race. It carries bundler and bot footprints and an unburned LP on a non-pump.fun deploy. Its market cap is below its liquidity and far below the leader's. The odds of an LP pull or fade are high. It could run on spillover from the leader, but this is not the coin to back.
